title: Recognize the sheaf tensor unit by its internal Hom
statement: For any small ringed site (J,R), if the internal-Hom endofunctor Hom(M,-) of a specified sheaf M is naturally isomorphic to the identity, then M is isomorphic to the genuine coefficient tensor unit. No native realization or action-site existence is asserted.

source.place: Sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints; Stacks 03EO.

proof.text: Curry the specified uncurried Hom isomorphism. Compose the sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction with this right-adjoint isomorphism to make tensorLeft M left adjoint to the identity. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorLeft M with the identity. Evaluate at the tensor unit and precompose with the inverse right unitor. The resulting isomorphism identifies M with the coefficient unit, including for the zero ring and empty site.
